arxiv-2012-11131.title: Weight-Based Exploration for Unmanned Aerial Teams Searching for Multiple Survivors Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2012-11131.creator: Sarthak J. Shetty, Debasish Ghose
arxiv-2012-11131.description: Abstract During floods, reaching survivors in the shortest possible time is a priority for rescue teams. Given their ability to explore difficult terrain in short spans of time, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have become an increasingly valuable aid to search and rescue operations.

arxiv-2110-12995.title: Tracking Control for ( 𝒙 , 𝒖 ) \boldsymbol{(x,u)} -Flat Systems by Quasi-Static Feedback of Classical States
arxiv-2110-12995.creator: Conrad GSTÖTTNER, Bernd KOLAR and Markus SCHÖBERL
arxiv-2110-12995.description: Abstract It is well known that for flat systems the tracking control problem can be solved by utilizing a linearizing quasi-static feedback of generalized states. If measurements (or estimates) of a so-called generalized Brunovský state are available, a linear, decoupled and asymptotically stable tracking error dynamics can be achieved.

arxiv-2301-10849.title: Two-loop helicity amplitudes for 𝑯 + H+ jet production to higher orders in the dimensional regulator Preprint: ZU-TH 07/23, TUM-HEP 1451/23
arxiv-2301-10849.creator: Thomas Gehrmann, Petr Jakubčík, Cesare Carlo Mella, Nikolaos Syrrakos, Lorenzo Tancredi
arxiv-2301-10849.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Thomas Gehrmann, Petr Jakubčík, Cesare Carlo Mella, Nikolaos Syrrakos, Lorenzo Tancredi. In view of the forthcoming High-Luminosity phase of the LHC, next-to-next-to-next-to-leading (N 3 LO) calculations for the most phenomenologically relevant processes become necessary.

arxiv-2311-04087.title: Spin-Flavor Oscillations of Relic Neutrinos in Primordial Magnetic Field
arxiv-2311-04087.creator: Ashutosh Kumar Alok, Trambak Jyoti Chall, Neetu Raj Singh Chundawat, Arindam Mandal
arxiv-2311-04087.description: Abstract The neutrino magnetic moment operator clasps a tiny but non-zero value within the standard model (SM) of particle physics and rather enhanced values in various new physics models. This generation of the magnetic moment ( μ ν \mu_{\nu} ) is through quantum loop corrections which can exhibit spin-flavor oscillations in the presence of an external magnetic field.

arxiv-2312-00707.title: On the Periodicity of Singular Vectors and the Holomorphic Block-Circulant SVD on the Unit Circumference
arxiv-2312-00707.creator: Giovanni Barbarino
arxiv-2312-00707.description: Abstract We investigate the singular value decomposition of a rectangular matrix that is analytic on the complex unit circumference, which occurs, e.g., with the matrix of transfer functions representing a broadband multiple-input multiple-output channel. Our analysis is based on the Puiseux series expansion of the eigenvalue decomposition of analytic para-Hermitian matrices on the complex unit circumference.

arxiv-2402-07584.title: Privacy-Optimized Randomized Response for Sharing Multi-Attribute Data Thanks: This work was supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Numbers 20H05967, 21H05052, 23H03345, and 23K18501 and JSPS Grant-in-Aid for JSPS Fellows Grant Number 23KJ0649.
arxiv-2402-07584.creator: Akito Yamamoto, Tetsuo Shibuya
arxiv-2402-07584.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Akito Yamamoto, Tetsuo Shibuya. With the increasing amount of data in society, privacy concerns in data sharing have become widely recognized. Particularly, protecting personal attribute information is essential for a wide range of aims from crowdsourcing to realizing personalized medicine. Although various differentially private methods based on randomized response have been proposed for single attribute information or specific analysis purposes such as frequency estimation, there is a lack of studies on the mechanism for sharing individuals’ multiple categorical information itself.

arxiv-2502-13531.title: Quotients of skew polynomial rings: new constructions of division algebras and MRD codes
arxiv-2502-13531.creator: F.J. Lobillo, Paolo Santonastaso, John Sheekey
arxiv-2502-13531.description: Abstract We achieve new results on skew polynomial rings and their quotients, including the first explicit example of a skew polynomial ring where the ratio of the degree of a skew polynomial to the degree of its bound is not extremal.

pmc-10751504.title: The clinical and histopathological characteristics of thyroid gland diseases in adolescents requiring surgical treatment: a ten-year follow-up study
pmc-10751504.creator: Vladimir Pantelic, Sasa Zunjic, Ivan Paunovic, Vladan Zivaljevic, Miljana Pilipovic, Ivan Radosavljevic
pmc-10751504.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The present research aimed to determine the clinical and pathohistological characteristics of thyroid gland diseases in adolescents who were previously surgically treated at the Endocrine Surgery Center of the University Medical Center of Serbia from 01/01/2001 to 01/01/2011. The study covered 170 patients of both sexes from the population of adolescents (aged 16 to 20 years) with various malignant and benign thyroid gland diseases.

pmc-12613587.title: Risk prediction of early-onset myocardial infarction using plasma proteomics, conventional risk factors, and polygenic risk score
pmc-12613587.creator: Zhong-Yue Liu, Fei Fang, Yu-Wen Qian, Ji-Mei Gu, Jun-Yu Zhao, Jie-Qiong Lyu, Meng-Yuan Miao, Hai-Peng Wang, Cai-Long Chen, Guo-Chong Chen
pmc-12613587.description: Background and objectivesEpidemiological trends indicate a concerning rise in early-onset cases of myocardial infarction (MI). We aimed to assess and compare the ability of plasma proteomics, conventional risk factors, and polygenic risk score (PRS) for the risk prediction of early-onset myocardial infarction (EOMI).MethodsIncluded were 13,097 participants aged 50 or younger, without prevalent cardiovascular diseases.

pmc-13135132.title: Animal Models of Hunner‐Type Interstitial Cystitis
pmc-13135132.creator: Yoshiyuki Akiyama, Yi Luo
pmc-13135132.description: BackgroundAnimal models are crucial for mechanistic studies and therapeutic development of human diseases. At present, the etiology of interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome (IC/BPS), a chronic disease of the urinary bladder, remains undefined. Therefore, numerous theories of pathogenesis have been proposed, and various animal models have been developed based on these theories.

pmc-13577178.title: Associations between prenatal phthalate exposure and maternal immune cell profiles across trimesters
pmc-13577178.creator: Yi Zhang, Lin Tao
pmc-13577178.description: IntroductionPhthalates (PAEs) are endocrine-disrupting chemicals, yet the association between prenatal PAE exposure and maternal blood immune cells remains unclear. Here, we enrolled 2,581 pregnant women, including 287 in the first trimester (gestational weeks 1–12), 807 in the second trimester (gestational weeks 13–27), and 1,487 in the third trimester (gestational weeks 28 to delivery).
